items.question: What are the steps to book a doctor appointment?
items.answer: To book an appointment, open the "Book Appointment" section in the app [FAQ-000009]. You must select a doctor, a date, and an available time slot [FAQ-000009, FAQ-000010]. You can only choose from a doctor's listed working days and available slots [FAQ-000012]. Finally, enter the reason for your visit [FAQ-000009]. Once these steps are completed, the booking status will begin as "requested" [FAQ-000009].

Q: What information do I need to book an appointment? A: You need the doctor, the date, the time slot, and a short reason for the visit.
Q: Where can I see a doctor's fee? A: Each doctor's fee is shown in the doctor list when booking.
Q: How do I choose a time slot? A: Only the doctor's working days and listed slots can be booked. A slot that is already booked cannot be chosen.
Q: How do I choose the right doctor? A: The doctor list shows each doctor's specialization, fee, and working days. The assistant can suggest a specialization, but it is not medical advice.

items.question: How does the clinic waitlist work?
items.answer: The waitlist allows you to wait for a full day or slot with a doctor [FAQ-000029]. You can join the waitlist when your desired slot or day is full, with a limit of one open entry per doctor and day [FAQ-000030]. When a slot becomes available, the next patient on the list receives an offer [FAQ-000029]. You will be notified of an offer via the bell icon and in "My Appointments" [FAQ-000031, FAQ-000039]. You have 120 minutes to accept the offer in "My Appointments" [FAQ-000032, FAQ-000039]. If you do not accept within this time, the offer expires and passes to the next patient [FAQ-000032].
contexts: Q: What is the waitlist? A: The waitlist lets you wait for a full day or slot with a doctor. When a slot is freed, the next patient on the waitlist gets an offer.
Q: How do I join the waitlist? A: Join the waitlist when the slot or day you want is full. You can have one open waitlist entry per doctor and day.

Q: How long do I have to accept a waitlist offer? A: You have 120 minutes to accept the offer. Accept it in My Appointments. If you do not accept it in time, the offer expires and the slot then passes to the next patient on the waitlist.
Q: How will I know I got a waitlist offer? A: You get a notification under the bell icon. The offer also appears in My Appointments.
Q: Will I be notified about waitlist offers? A: Yes, you get a notification when a waitlist slot is offered. You have 120 minutes to accept it.

items.question: Is the AI assistant a replacement for medical advice from a doctor?
items.answer: No, the AI assistant is not a replacement for medical advice from a doctor. The assistant provides only general information and specialization guidance [FAQ-000067, FAQ-000115, FAQ-000073]. It does not diagnose conditions [FAQ-000067]. Furthermore, the assistant cannot change prescriptions, as only your doctor has the authority to do so [FAQ-000046]. Any guidance provided is not medical advice, and a doctor will perform a formal assessment during your visit [FAQ-000115, FAQ-000073].
contexts: Q: Is the AI assistant giving medical advice? A: No, the assistant gives general information and specialization guidance only. It is not medical advice and does not diagnose.
Q: Can the AI assistant change my medicines? A: No, the assistant cannot change medicines. Only your doctor can change a prescription.
Q: How do I choose the right doctor? A: The doctor list shows each doctor's specialization, fee, and working days. The assistant can suggest a specialization, but it is not medical advice.

Q: I have been worrying constantly for months and feel restless. Which doctor should I see? A: These symptoms are usually seen by our Psychiatry team. You can book Dr. Ishrat Jahan, Dr. Faisal Karim, or Dr. Mahbuba Rahman in the app. This is general guidance, not medical advice; the doctor will assess you at the visit.

Q: I have a sudden high fever and pain behind my eyes. Which doctor should I see? A: These symptoms are usually seen by our General Medicine team. You can book Dr. Farhana Kabir, Dr. Tanvir Ahmed, or Dr. Nusrat Jahan in the app. This is general guidance, not medical advice; the doctor will assess you at the visit.

# Opening hours and contact

## Hours

- **Saturday to Thursday:** 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Dhaka time).
- **Friday and public holidays:** closed.

Each doctor works on set days and times within these hours. The doctor list in **Book Appointment** shows each doctor's working days, and only their listed slots can be booked.

## Contact

- **Phone:** +880 1711-000000 (reception, during opening hours)
- **Address:** House 27, Road 9/A, Dhanmondi, Dhaka 1209

Reception staff speak Bangla and English.

## Getting here

- Only limited street parking is available.
- There is a wheelchair ramp and a lift at the entrance.

## Outside opening hours

You can still book, cancel, and reschedule in the app at any time. Reception confirms new bookings on the next working day. For emergencies, call 999 or go to the nearest hospital emergency department.

Hours can change around public holidays and during Ramadan. Call reception to check before you travel.

reference_contexts:
# Cancellation policy

## How to cancel

Open **My Appointments** in the app and cancel the appointment. You can also ask the assistant. It prepares a cancellation card, and nothing changes until you press **Confirm** on that card.

## Which appointments can be cancelled

- Only appointments with status **requested** or **confirmed** can be cancelled.
- Completed appointments cannot be cancelled. Book a new follow-up appointment instead.
- Once cancelled, an appointment cannot be restored. Book again if you change your mind.

## Fees

There is no cancellation fee, and there is no minimum notice period. You can cancel at any time before the visit. Please cancel as early as you can so the slot can go to another patient.

## What happens to the freed slot

When you cancel, the slot is offered automatically to the next patient on the waitlist for that doctor and day.

## Cancelling for someone else

Each patient cancels from their own account. Reception staff can also cancel an appointment for you. Call +880 1711-000000 during opening hours.

items.question: How long do I have to accept a slot offered from the waitlist?
items.answer: You have 120 minutes to accept a waitlist offer [FAQ-000032, FAQ-000039]. You must accept the offer through My Appointments [FAQ-000032]. If you do not accept the offer within this timeframe, it will expire and the slot will be offered to the next patient on the waitlist [FAQ-000032, FAQ-000033].
contexts: Q: How long do I have to accept a waitlist offer? A: You have 120 minutes to accept the offer. Accept it in My Appointments. If you do not accept it in time, the offer expires and the slot then passes to the next patient on the waitlist.
Q: Will I be notified about waitlist offers? A: Yes, you get a notification when a waitlist slot is offered. You have 120 minutes to accept it.
Q: My waitlist offer expired. What now? A: An offer not accepted within 120 minutes expires, and the slot passes to the next patient on the waitlist. You can join the waitlist again.
items.ground_truth: You have 120 minutes to accept a waitlist offer. The offer appears in My Appointments and under the bell icon; if you do not accept in time it expires.
reference_contexts:
# Waitlist

## When to use it

Join the waitlist when the day or slot you want with a doctor is fully booked. If the slot you want is free, book it directly instead.

## Rules for joining

- Choose today or a future date on one of the doctor's working days.
- You can name one taken slot, or leave the slot open to accept any time that day.
- You can have one open waitlist entry per doctor and day.

## Offers

When a matching appointment is cancelled or moved, the slot is offered to the next waiting patient. Patients who asked for that exact slot come first, then the earliest to join.

- You get a notification under the bell icon, and the offer appears in **My Appointments**.
- You have **120 minutes** to accept the offer.
- An accepted offer becomes a booking with status **requested**, which reception then confirms.
- If you decline, or do not accept in time, the slot passes to the next patient. You stay on the waitlist for other slots that day.

## Leaving

You can leave the waitlist at any time from My Appointments. Entries for dates that have passed close automatically.

items.question: Is my appointment confirmed as soon as I book it?
items.answer: No, your appointment is not confirmed immediately upon booking. When you first book an appointment, it begins with a "requested" status, meaning reception has not yet confirmed it [FAQ-000009, FAQ-000013]. Reception confirms requested bookings within the same working day, which are Saturday through Thursday [FAQ-000015]. You will know your appointment is confirmed when the status changes to "confirmed" in the My Appointments section of the app [FAQ-000014].
contexts: Q: How will I know my appointment is confirmed? A: The status changes to confirmed in My Appointments. You also receive a reminder within the 24 hours before the visit.
Q: How long does confirmation take? A: Reception confirms requested bookings within the same working day. Working days are Saturday to Thursday.
Q: Will I get a reminder before my appointment? A: Yes, a reminder is sent within the 24 hours before a confirmed appointment. Reminders appear under the bell icon in the app.
Q: How do I book an appointment? A: Open Book Appointment in the app. Choose a doctor, a date, and a time slot, then enter the reason for the visit. The booking starts with status requested.
Q: What does requested status mean? A: Requested means reception has not confirmed the booking yet. Reception confirms it within the same working day.
items.ground_truth: No. A new booking starts as requested until reception confirms it (usually the same or next working day). Confirmed status appears in My Appointments.
reference_contexts:
# Booking rules

## How to book

Open **Book Appointment** in the app. Choose a doctor, a date, and a time slot, and enter a short reason for the visit. The assistant can also prepare a booking card. Nothing is booked until you press **Confirm**.

## Rules

- You can only book one of the doctor's working days and one of their listed time slots.
- A slot that is already booked cannot be chosen. You can join the waitlist instead.
- Each patient books from their own account. Family members need their own accounts.
- You can book any future working day. There is no limit on how far ahead you book.

## Status

- **Requested**: reception has not confirmed the booking yet. Reception usually confirms it on the same or the next working day.
- **Confirmed**: shown in My Appointments. You get a reminder within the 24 hours before the visit.
- **Completed**: the consultation has taken place.

## Walk-ins

Walk-in patients are seen only if a slot is free. Booking in the app is preferred.

## On the day

- Bring photo ID, previous prescriptions, and recent test reports.
- If you arrive more than 15 minutes late, you may need to reschedule.

You do not pay when you book. Payment is made at reception after your visit, once your bill has been created. Because nothing is paid in advance, cancelling or rescheduling never costs you anything and there is nothing to refund.

## No refund process

The clinic does not have a refund process for completed consultations.

## If you think your bill is wrong

- Check your bill in the app. The assistant can show it to you.
- Contact reception on +880 1711-000000 during opening hours, or ask at the front desk on your next visit.
- Do not pay a bill you believe is wrong until reception has checked it.
- If you paid twice or were charged in error, reception checks the bill and returns the extra amount in cash.
